ideas.Retries: Trying a failed call again, in the hope it works the next time.
ideas.Transient errors: Failures that pass on their own, so trying again can work.
ideas.Exponential backoff: Waiting longer after each failure, each wait a multiple of the last.
ideas.Jitter: A random amount taken from a wait, so many clients don't act at the same moment.
ideas.Idempotency keys: A key sent with a request, so the same request sent twice is carried out once.
ideas.Timeouts: Giving up on a call that takes too long, so the caller can move on.
ideas.Authorisation holds: Holding money for a payment first, and taking it only once the payment is settled.
ideas.Double-entry bookkeeping: Recording every movement of money twice: once as it leaves an account, once as it arrives.
ideas.Database transactions: A group of changes to a database made together, or not at all.
ideas.Advisory locks: A lock a program names and the database keeps, meaning whatever the program says.
ideas.HMAC: A code made from a message and a shared secret, proving who sent it and that it wasn't changed.
ideas.Constant-time comparison: Comparing secrets in a way that takes the same time whatever they hold.
ideas.Unique keys: A rule that no two rows of a table may share a value.
